changes: Detect Fire TV through manufacturer/system feature and installed store packages; display Amazon Appstore instead of a fixed Google Play label
Open the installed store through explicit native package launch intents; support Amazon URI search and launcher fallback
Installed-app and store searches open a native Android EditText dialog, request the system keyboard and preserve current text
Separate installed-app filter submission from Amazon/Google store search; cancel preserves the previous query
Store labels and search dialog actions support Arabic, English, French, Chinese and Japanese
Preserve 0.8.131 channel switching, previous/next episodes and contained episode lists
validation: Production StoreAccess with mocked Android intents: Fire priority, alternate Amazon package, encoded query, fallback and absent store
Actual built TV UI with mocked native bridge: both store buttons, native text-entry request, existing query and distinct store search in five languages
Live-channel/search and episode-navigation browser regression fixtures
Signed APKs, matching embedded receiver packages and release checksums
limitations: No physical Fire TV attached: actual Amazon Appstore launch and Fire keyboard rendering require device confirmation
Store availability also depends on the installed/enabled Amazon store and device setup
